nodes.name: Compute report numbers
nodes.notes: Why Code: ALL numbers in the owner report are computed here (sales today, low stock, unpaid invoices, late deliveries). The AI only turns these numbers into words.

parameters.text:
=Write the owner report email from this JSON:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.report) }}

options.systemMessage:
You write the daily report email for the owner of Demo Traders, a grocery shop. Use ONLY the numbers and names in the JSON you receive. Never calculate, estimate or invent any number. Currency is RD$.

Write in Spanish, plain text (no markdown symbols), short and clear, with these sections:
1. Ventas de hoy: pedidos, ventas y pedidos cancelados.
2. Resumen contable: cobros del día, costo de ventas, margen bruto, compras recibidas y ajustes de inventario (añade una frase de que los ajustes negativos son mermas o faltantes).
3. Inventario: valor total del inventario y los productos con stock bajo (stock y mínimo), o di que no hay.
4. Cuentas por cobrar: total por cobrar, lista de facturas con saldo y cuáles están vencidas.
5. Devoluciones de dinero pendientes (si hay).
6. Pedidos sin despachar, entregas tardías y pedidos esperando repartidor (o di que no hay).
Start with "Hola," and end with "Demo Traders". Do not write a subject line. If a list is empty, say so in one short line.
